plans.name: Ultramodern MF SSR Contract Closure
plans.overview: Close the current ambiguity around federated remote SSR by either implementing true server remote rendering or formally blessing typed SSR fallback plus client hydration as the enforced UltraModern contract.

todos.content: Re-audit routes-tanstack-mf and runtime MF SSR surfaces after the latest TanStack update to decide whether server remote rendering is implementable now with existing hooks.
If implementable, add the missing plugin or runtime seam and prove server-rendered remote components in routes-tanstack-mf.
If not implementable now, promote typed SSR fallback plus client hydration from gap marker to official contract with telemetry, docs, and negative tests.
Update validation gates so MF SSR behavior is explicit, enforced, and no longer documented as an ambiguous gap.

plans.name: Ultramodern SuperApp Contract Doctor
plans.overview: Add a fast diagnostic command that validates an UltraModern workspace before real SuperApp code is written.

todos.content: Define doctor checks for presetUltramodern, @modern-js/plugin-tanstack, latest TanStack versions, Effect services, MF topology, design-system remote policy, ownership metadata, and shared-package boundaries.
Implement human-readable and JSON doctor output by reusing existing topology, template manifest, design-system, dependency, and release-gate validators.

Add actionable fix suggestions for stale TanStack versions, deprecated TanStack runtime fields, missing topology metadata, missing MF SSR flags, missing Effect request-context propagation, and forbidden shared-package roles.
Wire doctor checks into generated workspace scripts and the preflight CI profile.

plans.name: Ultramodern SuperApp Local Control Plane
plans.overview: Reuse existing SuperApp certification process-control machinery to run generated shell, remotes, design-system remote, and services locally with stable ports, readiness probes, logs, and teardown.

todos.content: Extract reusable process, port, readiness, metrics, and teardown helpers from SuperApp certification without breaking destroy-run behavior.
Add local topology runner for generated UltraModern workspaces that starts services, remotes, design-system remote, and shell in dependency order.
Add rehearsal modes for remote unavailable, version skew, design-system bad release, and service unavailable using topology overlays.
Validate deterministic startup, failure classification, log and artifact output, and teardown in generated workspace fixtures.

plans.name: Ultramodern SuperApp Preflight Readiness Pack
plans.overview: Package the latest TanStack stack, runtime polish, generator, local control plane, doctor, MF SSR decision, docs, and gates into one preflight path that proves teams can start SuperApp development without first building a real SuperApp.

todos.content: Add one preflight command that generates a temporary workspace, runs doctor checks, validates topology, starts local processes, and executes minimal smoke gates.
Publish a concise greenfield SuperApp getting-started guide built around the preflight command and latest TanStack stack.
Add a generated-workspace CI profile that is stronger than docs-only validation but cheaper than full destroy certification.
Produce final readiness evidence showing a team can bootstrap and validate UltraModern without writing business-domain SuperApp code.

plans.name: Ultramodern SuperApp Workspace Generator
plans.overview: Add a first-class generator path that creates the canonical UltraModern Micro Vertical workspace without requiring manual shell, remote, service, design-system, topology, and script composition.

todos.content: Define generated workspace output for root config, shell, two vertical remotes, one design-system MF remote, one Effect service, shared packages, topology overlays, and validation scripts.
Extend @modern-js/create with one UltraModern workspace generation path while keeping presetUltramodern as the only public preset.
Generate topology metadata, ownership metadata, local overlays, package scripts, and template manifest evidence from repo-backed fixtures.
Add generator tests that scaffold the workspace and verify layout, package versions, config wiring, MF remote roles, Effect service wiring, and validation commands.

plans.name: Ultramodern TanStack Latest Dependencies
plans.overview: Refresh every UltraModern TanStack dependency to the current registry versions, align generated workspaces and fixtures, and make stale TanStack versions fail fast before deeper SuperApp preflight work starts.

todos.content: Re-check npm registry latest versions for TanStack Router, TanStack History, and any TanStack tooling used by the plugin or generated apps before editing package files.
Update @modern-js/plugin-tanstack, create templates, TanStack fixtures, Module Federation shared-version metadata, and pnpm-lock.yaml so they agree on the latest supported TanStack stack.
Add or update tests that fail when generated UltraModern apps emit stale TanStack dependency versions or mismatched MF shared requiredVersion values.
Run the focused plugin, create-template, routes-tanstack, and routes-tanstack-mf validation set and record the refreshed dependency evidence.

plans.name: Ultramodern TanStack Runtime Polish
plans.overview: Remove transitional TanStack runtime baggage and make @modern-js/plugin-tanstack the only polished TanStack path for UltraModern SuperApp development.

todos.content: Remove explicit deprecated TanStack fields from internal runtime context and update tests to assert only generic router runtime fields are used.
Audit and remove or quarantine the old in-runtime TanStack implementation path so generated apps use @modern-js/plugin-tanstack rather than @modern-js/runtime/tanstack-router.

Align TanStack SSR hydration, matched-route snapshots, action handoff, and lifecycle hooks around routerRuntime, routerInstance, routerHydrationScript, routerMatchedRouteIds, and routerServerSnapshot.
Add focused tests proving no deprecated TanStack-specific runtime context fields, exports, or generated code survive in the UltraModern path.
